verdict.rationale: Sunbiz is an online filing service that holds user-submitted data, so a data-retention and deletion question is a fair one to ask of it. However, the evidence only shows updating filing contents (adding or deleting officer names and addresses on annual reports) and dissolving entities. Neither is user control over how long the service keeps data or a way to delete one's data, so this is adjacent at most and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
